newsitem.title: USA: Commercial Federal acquires Heritage Fin'l.
newsitem.headline: Commercial Federal acquires Heritage Fin'l.

text.p: Commercial Federal Corp said Tuesday it completed the previously announced acquisition of Heritage Financial Ltd, parent company of Hawkeye FSB based in Boone, Iowa.

In the transaction, Commercial Federal acquired the 180,762 shares of Heritage's common stock. Each share of Heritage common will be exchanged for $18.73 in cash and 2.4985 shares of Commercial Federal common.
Commercial Federal acquired Hawkeye's six branch offices, assets of about $182 million and deposits of about $159 million.
